name: Alien Pod
comment: Also what the Alien Reaper Overlord spawns, four at a time north, east, south and west of himself (379720, SpawnMonster J27F at RelXPos/RelZPos ±2; the user, 2026-10-30). Matching J27F to this template is a guess. The client's spawn visuals (440781: 3 s stunned, then the client sets the look to the Mantis Nymph's) suggest it hatches by itself; here it hatches like the placed pods when a player comes close.
